mathematical_lesson: Semantic multiplicity and multi-row support are not coercive cover growth. Exact accumulated neighborhood twins on both sides, followed by a source-polarity upper cover, can absorb genuine obstruction multiplicity.

proposed_reusable_method_delta.name: bidirectional full-history twin gate before amplification claims
preconditions: a mathematical amplification claim is based on formula count, active rows, residual-language count, or another semantic multiplicity proxy
the target quantity admits a proved upper construction from exact row or column neighborhood classes
steps: define exact completion residuals at the registered split
classify equal residuals analytically and give separating witnesses
include every accumulated old band and fallback contribution
classify exact neighborhoods on both sides
apply the cheapest polarity-correct type-class or quotient upper cover
credit amplification only after a direct quotient nonmultiplexability discriminator survives
proposed_reusable_method_delta.transfer_condition: If the full accumulated bipartite complement has exact row and column neighborhood-type counts t_row,t_column and graph rectangles lift in the registered polarity, then rho(G)<=D_intersection(G)<=min(t_row,t_column).
falsifiers: a proposed twin class contains vertices with different full complement neighborhoods
an old band or fallback edge creates an unaccounted type collision or split
the cover polarity is reversed or the type-class rectangles do not cover the target graph
a direct proof shows the quotient cover grows despite slowly growing type counts
non_guarantees: does not say semantic multiplicity is never useful
does not turn an upper-bound falsifier into a lower-bound method
does not establish a uniform theorem from one finite level
does not promote application evidence into RAKL framework authority
